name: backlog-tools
description: Backlog-native skills for the Backlog product itself, shared by every host — install it in Claude Desktop and in herdr alike: writing a Backlog import plan from an agreed specification, running one item of such a plan when it is pasted back out of the app, moving an entry to Done once its pull request merges, checking a finished plan once at the end — what landed against the plan, that it all builds, and fixing the gaps the person accepts — turning another to-do tool's export into an inbox import manifest, answering the private reading notes the app holds on a repository's Devbook chapters, reporting what the week's delivery runs cost in tokens across every repository, running the GTD weekly review over the Inbox, the Brain and the backlog without changing anything, tending the Second Brain notes folder by the rules it carries, filing a Backlog task for each remark routed to one and triaging the app's inbox into it, levelling a devbook and its code in the sync direction Backlog keeps for each unit, as draft pull requests, keeping the person's goals current — attaching new work to a goal, proposing impediments, and reporting each goal's standing and next step — and bringing a long-running session level with its base branch, re-checking the artifacts, import plans, branch and pull requests it produced against what landed; plus a Claude Code hook that forwards a session's tool and token telemetry to the app. The Claude Desktop-only parts live in backlog-desktop, the herdr-only ones in backlog-herdr.
